zh-Hans.name: DeepReader: Read with AI
zh-Hans.subtitle: 结合上下文理解文档与电子书
zh-Hans.promotional_text: 选中词句，结合上下文获得简短解释，继续追问并保存阅读记录。支持 PDF、EPUB 等格式、评分和书单。AI 功能需要您自己的服务商 API Key，费用与额度由服务商决定。
zh-Hans.keywords: 阅读,电子书,文献,语境,笔记,高亮,书单,总结,PDF,EPUB
zh-Hans.description:
DeepReader 是一款原生 Mac 文档与电子书阅读器，将阅读、语境解释和阅读记录放在同一窗口中。

理解词句的实际含义
选中单词、短语或句子，按 ⌘⇧D，结合附近上下文获取简短解释。还可继续追问，保存成功的查询和回答，方便以后复习。

阅读多种格式
支持 PDF、EPUB、TXT、Markdown，以及未加 DRM 的 MOBI 和 AZW3。电子书可切换章节并保存本地高亮；PDF 支持高亮批注及保存。

按自己的节奏整理
调整 AI 侧栏宽度，或切换为悬浮窗口。为书籍评分、标记阅读状态、按星级归档原格式副本，并在书单中搜索和重新打开。

回顾阅读内容
手动生成文件全文总结，或根据已保存的记录生成日、周、月总结。发送前先查看本地统计和预计请求数。

使用前请了解
• 本地阅读、评分、归档和书单不需要 AI Key。
• AI 功能需要您自己的 DeepSeek API Key；密钥保存在 macOS 钥匙串。服务商可能收费，并设置额度和地区限制；应用不附送共享 Key 或无限免费 AI。
• AI 操作会向所选服务商发送相关文字。全文总结发送可提取全文；周期总结发送选定的保存记录。
• AI 回答可能出错，请结合原文核对。
• 不支持 DRM 保护电子书、Kindle KFX 或扫描文件 OCR。电子书搜索作用于当前章节。
• 支持中文和英文界面。

DeepReader 是独立项目，不是 SumatraPDF 或模型服务商的官方产品。

en-US.name: DeepReader: Read with AI
en-US.subtitle: Read with context
en-US.promotional_text: Read PDFs and ebooks, explain selected passages in context, and save your learning. AI features use your own provider API key; provider fees and quotas apply.
en-US.description:
DeepReader is a native Mac reader that brings documents, contextual explanations and saved reading records into one window.

Understand text in context
Select a word, phrase or sentence and press Command-Shift-D for a concise explanation based on nearby text. Ask follow-up questions and revisit successful conversations in History.

Read across formats
Open PDF, EPUB, TXT, Markdown, and DRM-free MOBI and AZW3 files. Navigate ebook chapters and save local highlights. Add and save PDF highlight annotations.

Organize your reading
Resize or float the AI sidebar. Rate books, mark Reading or Finished, archive original-format copies into rating folders, and search your book list.

Review what you have read
Manually generate document summaries or daily, weekly and monthly reviews from saved records. Preview local statistics and estimated request counts before generating a summary.

Before you begin
• Reading, ratings, archiving and book lists work without an AI key.
• AI features require your own DeepSeek API key, stored in macOS Keychain. Provider charges, quotas and regional availability apply. No shared key or unlimited free AI is included.
• AI actions send the relevant text to your chosen provider. Document summaries send extractable full text; period summaries send selected saved records.
• AI answers can be inaccurate. Check them against the source.
• DRM-protected books, Kindle KFX and OCR for scanned documents are not supported. Ebook search works within the current chapter.
• Chinese and English interface options are included.

DeepReader is an independent project, not an official product of SumatraPDF or the model providers.
